description: This PHP source file defines the 'ModuleStatusChange' event class within the 'OrangeHRM' HR management framework, representing a change in the status of a module by encapsulating previous and current module states.

classes.name: ModuleStatusChange
classes.description: An event class representing the change in status between two modules, encapsulating the previous and current module states.

methods.name: getPreviousModule
methods.description: Returns the previous state of the Module before the change.

methods.name: getCurrentModule
methods.description: Returns the current state of the Module after the change.
